items.notes: Explicit destination review accepts USDA 'Pumpkin flowers, raw' as a bounded squash-blossom-family nutrition reference for raw zucchini flowers/blossoms. The USDA record identifies raw Cucurbita spp. flowers, matching the uncooked edible flower form, but it does not certify zucchini versus pumpkin cultivar/species equivalence, blossom sex, maturity, cultivar, trimming fraction, or agricultural origin; confidence is therefore medium. Nutrition remains the USDA per-100-g raw flower reference with no edible-part, serving-mass, stuffing, frying, boiling, or other cooking conversion inferred. This decision is limited to plain raw zucchini flowers/blossoms; stuffed, cooked, fried, pickled, or zucchini-fruit identities remain separate.
